assets.notes: Nomograph/sizing chart for saturated steam at 3.5 bar gauge, 150°C. Left Y-axis: flow rate kg/h (250 to 100,000). Right Y-axis: flow rate kg/s. X-axis: pressure drop pa, bar/100 m length. Diagonal lines represent pipe sizes. Bold line indicates limit of design.
